_comment: THE FICTIONAL US CAST of the sandbox, the default demo (npm run sandbox): six invented Austin businesses, one at every stage of the funnel, for the fictional Austin studio Harbor & Pine Web Co. No real business, person or address: reserved .example domains (RFC 2606), NANP 555-01xx fiction numbers, Austin ZIP codes. Their built sites are demo stand-ins rendered by the sandbox from their own facts (a real run is in examples/). « seller »: the studio's fictional business details for Billing (a demo invoice prints whole).

reply.subject: Re: Your new website, a 30-second tour
reply.text: Hi Sam, this looks great. Call me Thursday morning and we'll go through it together.

story.rdvNote: Walkthrough Thursday 10 am at their yard
story.lostNote: Keeping their current site for now
story.callNote: No email on their site (the contact form is broken): call the office, Mon–Fri 7–11 am

feedback.text: Use a serif for the headlines, it feels more like a family business. And no stock phrases like “quality craftsmanship”: say what they actually do.
